entities.name: GTPase Obg (B8DVU1)
observations: Exact 100% sequence match over 570 aa to reviewed UniProt B8DVU1 from Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis AD011; annotated as essential Obg GTPase binding GTP, GDP and possibly (p)ppGpp.

Reported roles: cell-cycle control, stress response, ribosome biogenesis, and morphogenesis control in differentiating bacteria; GO annotations include GTP binding, GTPase activity, magnesium-ion binding, and ribosome biogenesis.
